shared_elements: a large figure with body and limbs occupying a prominent area
small repeated ornamental/sign-like units in rows (bands of beadwork in A, registers of signs in B)
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both surfaces include a single larger figural form plus small repeated units arranged in horizontal rows (beaded bands in A, registers of inscribed signs in B). A depicts a strictly symmetrical frontal winged anthropomorph with elaborate costume and outstretched feathered wings, whereas B is dominated by registers of small script-like signs with a single ambiguous relief figure, with no symmetry, no wings, and no comparable relationships between elements.
